assistant.title: Ask anything, or send your writing for review
assistant.body: The assistant answers your questions clearly and directly, and reviews IELTS writing against the official band descriptors: it finds and corrects your mistakes and shows you how to reach a higher band.
assistant.notReady: The AI assistant isn't switched on for this server yet (the AI service key is not configured). No reply is generated and nothing is taken from your quota until it is.
assistant.exhausted: You've used this month's assistant messages; they refill next period.
assistant.empty: Ask a question (IELTS, grammar, vocabulary or anything else), or choose “Writing review” and send your text.
assistant.thinking: The assistant is writing a reply…
assistant.reviewing: The assistant is reviewing your writing; this can take up to a minute…
assistant.mode.label: Request type
assistant.chat.label: Your question
assistant.chat.placeholder: e.g. What's the difference between present perfect and past simple? How should I conclude a Task 2 essay?
assistant.review.prompt: Task question (optional, but makes the review more accurate)
assistant.review.textPlaceholder: Write or paste your answer in English…
assistant.review.under: below this task's {n}-word minimum, which affects the band
assistant.review.minWords: Send at least {n} words of your writing for review.
assistant.estimateNote: Review bands are AI estimates, not official IELTS scores. After the review you can keep asking in the same conversation, e.g. “improve my introduction”.
assistant.loadError: Couldn't load your conversations. Please reopen the page.
practice.freeNote: On the free plan only part {n} of each skill is open (Listening/Speaking Part 1, Reading Passage 1, Writing Task 1). Premium opens every part.
mock.body: A full IELTS test in all four skills with real timing: Listening and Reading are marked against the key, Writing and Speaking are scored by AI on the four official criteria, and you get an estimated overall band.
mock.locked: Full mock tests are part of Premium.
mock.quota: {remaining} of {limit} mock tests left this month
mock.aiMissing: The AI service isn't configured on this server; mock Writing and Speaking won't be scored until it is.
mock.none: No mock test has been published yet. It will appear here once the content team reviews and publishes one.
mock.sectionsIntro: Take the sections in order. Each section's timer starts when you open it.
mock.notScored: No band recorded (empty answer or the AI service did not respond).
mock.timeUp: Time is up for this section; submit it.
mock.overallMissing: No overall band, because not every section received a band.
mock.estimate: This is an estimate, not an official IELTS score.
